name: Camping Blagaj (River Auto Camp, Buna) — Ravna fallback
description: Verified, contactable FALLBACK for the unverifiable Ravna Camping (N5, Jun 20). Real auto-camp on the Buna river right by Blagaj Tekija (a D5 stop anyway), hot showers + electricity. Use if Ravna can't be confirmed on the day.
communityNotes: Booked/contactable via autocamp-blagaj.com — unlike Ravna, this one is verifiable. On the Buna, walkable to the Tekija; arrive with daylight to pitch.

name: Voli supermarket (Žabljak) — Durmitor stock-up
description: The D8 grocery stock-up before the Durmitor ring, where shops thin out. Cheapest mainstream Montenegrin chain. Buy all camp food + the pre-06:00-start breakfast here the afternoon before the hike.
communityNotes: Open Mon-Sat ~07:30-21:30 (D8 = Tue). Stock up the evening before an alpine start; nothing opens early enough at the trailhead.

name: Tommy supermarket (Babino Polje, Mljet)
description: Largest shop on Mljet, in the Autokamp Mungos village — covers D4 breakfast + top-ups after the late post-ferry D3 arrival (there is also a Tommy at Sobra ferry port).
communityNotes: Do the heavy self-cater shop on the mainland before the D3 ferry; this is the on-island top-up for breakfast and the morning before the kayak.

name: Laundry / rest-day wash (Virpazar — Skadar base)
description: There is NO laundry stop in 13 days of camping + hiking + saltwater. The 2-night Skadar base (D9-10, Rvaši) is the only realistic wash window — make D10 the rest + laundry day. Pin anchors Virpazar centre.
communityNotes: Confirm a self-service machine in Virpazar on the day, or wash at the Rvaši house, or run to a Podgorica laundromat (~40 min). Treat as a rest-day chore, not a destination.
sources: coords = Virpazar centre (OSM); plan-gap reminder, not a verified laundromat
